headline: PwC rolls out Claude agents firm-wide on a quiet day
body: A quiet day with one story. PwC said it will roll out Anthropic's Claude Code and Cowork across its workforce, certifying tens of thousands of staff. Large-scale use of AI agents nudges up AI Autonomy, which gives a tiny lift to the endings where AI acts on its own, such as Benevolent Dictator, Descendants and Zookeeper. Horizon Balance is 1.9, barely changed (-0.01).
movers_note: Benevolent Dictator +0.1, Descendants +0.1 and Zookeeper +0.1, all from the PwC agent rollout (+0.09 each).
